title: router.py:482 except RoutingError never matches survey_source_route raises (dead handler)
description: Latent pre-existing issue found during 8dv7 round: src/lichen/routing/router.py:482 catches the LOCAL RoutingError class (router.py:44), but survey_source_route (imported from lichen.rpl.routing, which defines its own RoutingError at :32) may raise the lichen.rpl.routing.RoutingError — a different class. The handler can never match exceptions from survey_source_route, so invalid source-route headers would propagate instead of DROPping. Fix options: (a) catch the imported lichen.rpl.routing.RoutingError (restore the import under an alias), or (b) unify the exception classes if the local class was meant to be the same. Verify intended semantics with a repro test before fixing.
